descriptions.w3d_d31e_convert_image_801d95c4: Converts an image to another pixel format, in place when no destination is given (going through a temporary fetched with 0x801ea470 and swapped back with 0x801ea4c8). Sizes the destination, locks its data, finds a from/to pair in the 21-entry table 0x803af714 and calls its converter for every mip level, halving width and height. Returns the converter result, or 0x80004001 when no converter exists; 0 when nothing changes. Names are inferred.
